summary: A laid-off or transferred worker talks plainly with a spouse about money and moves and gives children little detail.
realLife: Autoworkers facing closure described nightly talks with a spouse about selling a house and moving in with relatives, saying they had no answers, and said little about what children are told.
sources: KOMO/Scripps News, Autoworker upheaval: Families split, children left behind: https://komonews.com/news/auto-matters/autoworker-upheaval-families-split-children-left-behind
inGame: a job-lost call from a relative can carry the plain talk; the relative tie sets how blunt; needs: household budget talk scenes

turns.writesBack: a later stronger tie strain when found out
